name: Booi
source:
A bellboy of the Gatewater Hotel who was called as a witness in [url=https://vndb.org/c3944]Maya Fey[/url]'s trial for the murder of [url=https://vndb.org/c3942]Mia Fey[/url].

He is honest and straightforward, willing to do anything for the reputation of his hotel. He had a crush on [url=https://vndb.org/c10881]April May[/url].

[spoiler]The bellboy's testimony allowed the defense attorney, [url=https://vndb.org/c3941]Phoenix Wright[/url], to deduce that May had shared her hotel room with someone else. The bellboy later wrote an affidavit for Wright after he showed him a photograph of [url=https://vndb.org/c10882]Redd White[/url], confirming that White had checked in with May. Wright would go on to prove that White was Mia's murderer. Following the case, the bellboy kept the room that May and White stayed in as it was and charged extra for it. The hotel experienced an increase in popularity, which seemed to benefit the bellboy, as he took over management of the hotel within the following months.

He often brought tea to Room 1202 of the Prosecutor's Building for [url=https://vndb.org/c10833]Miles Edgeworth[/url] (who was the prosecutor of Maya's trial). After one of Edgeworth's cases, he entered the office and found an apparent suicide note.

At some point, he became employed by the Gatewater Land theme park, where he would play the role of the Proto Badger. He talked to the still-alive Edgeworth inside his costume during one of the latter's investigations. [/spoiler]

[From [url=http://www.court-records.net/chara1-2.htm#bellboy]Court Records[/url]]
